scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten full-frame tiles have readable captions. Gold direct amodal rectangles appear only on positives.

At 0.5 cm/px a clear dark nearly horizontal tapered silhouette is inside the rectangle, tail/flukes left and nose right; at 1 cm/px the smaller silhouette remains distinct. At 2 cm/px a thin horizontal dark form remains discernible.
At 3–4 cm/px narrow dark marks remain discernible but anatomical form is poorly resolved. At 4 cm/px the gold box border occupies much of the few-pixel-high contact-sheet presentation.
No overlapping background animal is discernible in these tiles. All five negatives lack the central dark form and rectangle and look essentially uniform blue; they were retained and inspected.
No material paired-row background shading difference is apparent at this review scale. This does not establish bitwise/photometric pixel equality.

Ascent/rootdepth1.6m are actual retained-state metadata on a static mesh proxy. Biological pose/animation, water optics and exact visible/refracted outlines remain uncertified; machine visibility stays unknown.
